category_note: Hand-authored UI recreation (WhatsApp chat area), NOT a captured page — user-supplied content, no sourcing. No catalog block covers a chat conversation; closest kin is the social-overlay card family. Builder hand-authors per this plan using motion-vocabulary primitives.
style: Pixel-faithful WhatsApp light theme. Calm, real-feeling chat rhythm — the motion IS the product demo. Soft springs, no flash, no glitch. Embedded inside an iPhone mockup on a landing hero: the video is ONLY the message area (header + input bar are static HTML outside the video). Must loop perfectly: frame 0 and the last frame are both the empty chat background.
font: system-ui / -apple-system native stack (deliberate: WhatsApp mimicry — do NOT load an HF webfont)

borrow_primitives: scale_punch (back.out(2.2), softened to back.out(1.7) for bubble pops)
slide_bottom (bubbles enter from y:+24 with the pop)
slide_left (chips slide in from x:-16 under their bubble)
customize.loop: seamless — last rendered frame must equal frame 0 (empty #efeae2 background); no crossfade needed if both ends are empty

content.chat_background: #efeae2 (optionally a very faint WhatsApp-style doodle pattern at <4% opacity — skip if it risks banding in the render)

layout.container: single column, padding 24px horizontal, 20px bottom; messages anchored to the BOTTOM of the canvas and stacked upward, like a real chat
layout.stack_behavior: one wrapper element holds the whole message stack; each new bubble is measured, then the wrapper translates up by that height with a soft spring (y-only, back.out(1.4), ~0.45s) at the same moment the new bubble pops in from below — GPU transform only, never animate layout properties
layout.bubble_gap: 10px vertical between messages, 6px between a bubble and its chip

outgoing.meta: time 9px #8a8a8a + CheckCheck icon 12px, inline at bottom-right of the bubble; check color animates #8a8a8a -> #53bdeb

source_chip.style: pill, background rgba(255,255,255,0.7), border 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), text #6b7280 10px, padding 4px 10px, aligned left under its incoming bubble

handoff_chip.style: pill, background rgba(124,77,234,0.15), text #7c4dea 10px, padding 4px 10px, aligned left under its incoming bubble

typing_indicator.style: small incoming bubble (#ffffff, same radius) containing 3 dots 5px #9ca3af; dots loop a stagger y-bounce/opacity pulse (each 0.15s apart, ~0.9s cycle); the whole bubble pops in with scale_grow and pops out (scale to 0.85 + fade, 0.18s) right before the real message replaces it in the same slot

messages.text: Hola! ¿Qué necesito para cambiar mi plan?
¡Hola! Para cambiar de plan solo necesitás tu número de cliente. El cambio se hace sin costo y aplica desde el mes siguiente.
Sí. Te paso con alguien del equipo de Atención para dejarlo listo, ¿te parece? Ya le comparto tu consulta así no repetís nada.

chip.text: 👤 Derivando a una persona de tu equipo…

timeline.action: empty chat background (this exact frame is also the loop's final frame)
m1 pops in: slide_bottom(+24px) + scale_punch from 0.85, back.out(1.7), 0.35s; NO typing indicator for the user side
m1 checks color-shift #8a8a8a -> #53bdeb over 0.25s (≈400ms after appear, anticipated ~0.1s)
typing indicator (incoming) pops in; dots pulse
m2 pops in (same recipe as m1, left-anchored); stack springs up to make room
source chip slides in under m2: slide_left(-16px) + fade, power3.out, 0.3s
m3 pops in (outgoing); stack springs up
typing indicator (incoming) pops in; dots pulse
m4 pops in (incoming); stack springs up
handoff chip slides in under m4 (slide_left + fade, 0.3s)
handoff chip scale_pulse to 1.06, yoyo, sine.inOut, 0.5s total — the single accent beat of the piece
HOLD: full conversation readable, completely still (legibility >= 1.5s guaranteed)
global exit: whole stack fade_out (opacity -> 0) + drift y:-14px, power2.in, 0.8s
empty background held to 10.0 -> cuts seamlessly back to t=0 (perfect loop)

shot_brief: A silent 10s loop that lives inside the message area of an iPhone mockup: a WhatsApp support conversation writes itself in real time. The dominant motion idea is the chat spring — every bubble pops up from the bottom with a soft back-eased spring while the existing stack glides upward to receive it, exactly like a live chat. Micro-payoffs punctuate the rhythm: read-checks tick from gray to blue, a typing indicator breathes before each reply, a source-citation chip and a violet human-handoff chip slide in as proof points, the handoff chip giving the piece its single pulse accent. After a long readable hold, everything fades up and away, returning to the empty canvas so the loop restarts without a visible seam.
